environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on AWS Lambda via Bref runtime (bref/laravel-bridge 2.x). The Lambda function is configured with a Function URL using AuthType=NONE, making it publicly accessible without any authentication. The function has 512MB memory, 30s timeout, and runs in a VPC with public subnet access. No API Gateway or ALB sits in front - traffic hits the Function URL directly. Environment variables include APP_DEBUG=true and LOG_LEVEL=debug.
